analysis.description: This paper proposes a hybrid deep learning architecture named Block-State Transformer (BST), which combines State Space Models (SSMs) for long-range contextualization with Block Transformers for short-term sequence representation, specifically targeting improved performance in language modeling tasks. The study demonstrates that BST not only achieves better perplexity scores than conventional Transformer-based models on certain datasets but also provides significant computational speed gains through parallel execution.

type.justification: The paper presents empirical results comparing the performance and efficiency of the proposed Block-State Transformer with existing models on various datasets.
type.quote: We conduct experiments with BST on three different datasets, PG19, arXiv and GitHub, allowing us to test our method on a suite of varying documents lengths composed of English texts, latex scientific articles and source code.

name.justification: The paper focuses on enhancing language modeling tasks, particularly by addressing the limitations of existing Transformers and proposing hybrid models like BST that are efficient for longer sequences.
name.quote: In this work, we propose a hybrid layer named Block-State Transformer (BST), that internally combines an SSM sublayer for long-range contextualization, and a Block Transformer sublayer for short-term representation of sequences... We show that our model outperforms similar Transformer-based architectures on language modeling perplexity.
